spec.description: Internal performance dashboard for slurm_exporter: command durations, cache freshness, error rates, and scrape health. Use this to validate optimisations and detect slowdowns before they cause scrape failures.

spec.title: Collectors OK
spec.description: Number of collectors that succeeded on last scrape.

spec.title: Avg Duration per Command (last 5 min)
spec.description: Average execution time per Slurm command. High values indicate slurmctld load or network issues.

spec.title: Call Count per Command (last 5 min)
spec.description: Number of Slurm CLI executions per command. `sinfo` should be ~1 per scrape thanks to caching.

spec.title: Collectors FAIL
spec.description: Number of collectors that failed on last scrape. Should always be 0.

spec.title: Command Duration p99 Over Time
spec.description: 99th percentile execution time per command. Spikes indicate slurmctld overload or network issues. Alert threshold: 5s.

spec.title: Total Command Errors
spec.description: Total Slurm CLI command errors since exporter start.

spec.title: Command Error Rate
spec.description: Errors per second per command. Any value > 0 indicates a failed Slurm CLI call. Check slurmctld logs if persistent.

spec.title: Collector Scrape Duration
spec.description: Wall time per collector per scrape. Alert if any collector approaches scrape_timeout (default 25s).

spec.title: scontrol Cache Age
spec.description: Age of scontrol show nodes -o cache in seconds. Should be < 25s (TTL). -1 means not yet populated.

spec.title: scontrol Cache Age Over Time
spec.description: Age of scontrol show nodes -o cache. Should oscillate between 0 and TTL (25s). Flat line at TTL = cache never refreshing.

spec.title: sacct_efficiency Refresh Age
spec.description: Time since last sacct refresh. Flat beyond 2× interval = sacct failing. Panel empty if collector disabled.

spec.title: sacct Last Refresh
spec.description: Time since last sacct_efficiency refresh. Alert if > 2× interval. Shows 'N/A' if sacct_efficiency is disabled.

spec.title: Exporter Performance
